cases.script:
export GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-01-02T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-01-02T00:00:00Z'
cat_hook='#!/bin/sh
printf "called\\n" >> "$HOME/pre-count"
/bin/cat > "$HOME/pre-input"
printf "pre-stdout-marker\\n"
printf "pre-stderr-marker\\n" >&2
exit 0
'
printf '%b' "$cat_hook" >remote/custom-hooks/pre-receive
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'printf "%s %s %s\n" "$1" "$2" "$3" >> "$HOME/update-input"' 'case "$1" in refs/heads/b) exit 1;; esac' 'exit 0' >remote/custom-hooks/update
/usr/bin/chmod 755 remote/custom-hooks/pre-receive remote/custom-hooks/update
id=$(/usr/bin/git -C local rev-parse HEAD)
git -C local push -q ../remote main:refs/heads/a main:refs/heads/b >"$HOME/accepted.out" 2>"$HOME/accepted.err"; rc=$?
a=$(/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse --verify refs/heads/a 2>/dev/null)
/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse --verify refs/heads/b >"$HOME/b.out" 2>/dev/null; b_rc=$?
if [[ $rc == 1 && $a == "$id" && $b_rc != 0 ]]; then echo 'partial-update=correct'; else echo 'partial-update=wrong'; fi
if [[ $(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$HOME/pre-count") == 1 && $(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$HOME/pre-input") == 2 ]] && /usr/bin/grep -F "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 $id refs/heads/a" "$HOME/pre-input" >/dev/null && /usr/bin/grep -F "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 $id refs/heads/b" "$HOME/pre-input" >/dev/null; then echo 'pre-input=correct'; else echo 'pre-input=wrong'; fi
if [[ $(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$HOME/update-input") == 2 ]] && /usr/bin/grep -F "refs/heads/a 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 $id" "$HOME/update-input" >/dev/null && /usr/bin/grep -F "refs/heads/b 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 $id" "$HOME/update-input" >/dev/null; then echo 'update-input=correct'; else echo 'update-input=wrong'; fi
if /usr/bin/grep -F pre-stdout-marker "$HOME/accepted.err" >/dev/null && /usr/bin/grep -F pre-stderr-marker "$HOME/accepted.err" >/dev/null; then echo 'hook-output=forwarded'; else echo 'hook-output=missing'; fi
printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '/bin/cat > "$HOME/rejected-input"' 'printf rejected-by-hook >&2' 'exit 1' >remote/custom-hooks/pre-receive
/usr/bin/chmod 755 remote/custom-hooks/pre-receive
git -C local push -q ../remote main:refs/heads/c main:refs/heads/d >"$HOME/rejected.out" 2>"$HOME/rejected.err"; rc=$?
/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse --verify refs/heads/c >/dev/null 2>&1; c_rc=$?
/usr/bin/git --git-dir=remote rev-parse --verify refs/heads/d >/dev/null 2>&1; d_rc=$?
if [[ $rc == 1 && $c_rc != 0 && $d_rc != 0 && $(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$HOME/rejected-input") == 2 ]] && /usr/bin/grep -F 'remote rejected' "$HOME/rejected.err" >/dev/null; then echo 'pre-rejection=correct'; else echo 'pre-rejection=wrong'; fi
/usr/bin/rm -rf remote local
cases.oracle: System Git 2.47.3 and the candidate client each push to a fixture-only bare local receiver with a relative core.hooksPath.
cases.comparison: Verify one pre-receive invocation and both proposed tuples, per-ref update arguments and partial rejection, forwarding both hook output streams, and all-or-nothing pre-receive rejection.

cases.setup_script:
set -e
export TZ=UTC0 GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=Fixture GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=fixture@example.test GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=Fixture GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=fixture@example.test
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2020-03-01T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2020-03-01T00:00:00Z'
/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C fixture -f "$HOME/key"
/usr/bin/git init -q -b main signed
/usr/bin/git -C signed config gc.auto 0
/usr/bin/git -C signed config maintenance.auto false
printf 'signed\n' >signed/file
/usr/bin/git -C signed add file
/usr/bin/git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c user.signingKey="$HOME/key" commit -q -S -m signed
/usr/bin/git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c user.signingKey="$HOME/key" tag -s -m signed signed-tag
cases.script:
export TZ=UTC0 GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
read -r kt kk comment < "$HOME/key.pub"
printf 'fixture@example.test %s %s\n' "$kt" "$kk" > "$HOME/allowed"
/usr/bin/rm -f "$HOME/revoked"
git -C signed -c gpg.format=ssh -c gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile="$HOME/allowed" -c gpg.ssh.revocationFile="$HOME/revoked" verify-commit HEAD >"$HOME/revoked.out" 2>"$HOME/revoked.err"; rc=$?
if [[ $rc != 0 ]]; then echo 'missing=rejected'; else echo 'missing=accepted'; fi
/usr/bin/rm -rf signed
cases.oracle: System Git and OpenSSH reject verification when the configured revocation file is missing.
cases.comparison: The empty-regular-file exception must not turn missing or unreadable revocation data into success.
